---
title: "Resources"
subtitle: "Curating academic publications, teaching syllabi, datasets, and research tools"
---

The `rc42_resources_workflow` spreadsheet contains curated academic materials displayed on the [Resources page](https://isa-rc42.org/resources/). It allows RC42 to maintain a directory of sociological social psychology literature, teaching materials, and open research data.

## Where the information is stored

Resources are managed in Google Drive:

```
Google Drive
└── Core Spreadsheets
    └── rc42_resources_workflow
```

## Publication requirements

Adding a row to the spreadsheet does not publish it automatically. To ensure that incomplete or broken entries are not displayed on the website, an entry must meet two requirements:

1. It must contain a working web address in the `URL` column.
2. The value in `Verification status` must begin with the word `Verified` (for example, `Verified official source` or `Verified academic source`).

## Example of a published resource entry

A complete resource record includes:

* **Title:** *Handbook of the Social Psychology of Inequality*
* **URL:** `https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-94-017-9002-4`
* **Category:** `Publications`
* **Verification status:** `Verified official source`
* **Priority rank:** `1` (lower numbers appear higher on the page)
* **Tags:** `inequality; status; stratification; handbook`
* **Author / Institution:** `Jane McLeod, Edward Lawler, Michael Schwalbe (Eds.)`
* **Description:** `An overview of sociological social psychology approaches to social inequality and stratification.`

## Resource fields reference

| Column header | Purpose | Accepted values |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `Title` | Title of the resource | Mandatory. Enter full descriptive title. |
| `URL` | Web address | Mandatory. Must be an active URL (such as `https://...`). |
| `Verification status` | Editorial approval switch | Mandatory. Must start with `Verified` (e.g. `Verified official source`). |
| `Category` | Main thematic section on the website | `Publications`, `Teaching Resources`, or `Datasets & Tools`. |
| `Priority rank` | Display order rank | Enter `1` for featured resources, `2` for secondary, or `0` for default alphabetical ordering. |
| `Tags` | Topic keywords | Semicolon- or comma-separated terms (e.g. `emotions; identity; surveys`). |
| `Author / Institution` | Authors or publishing institution | Recommended for academic citation. |
| `Description` | Summary of the resource | Recommended 1–3 sentence overview. |

## Community-submitted resources

When an administrator approves a community contribution categorized as a resource in `ISA RC42 Community Submissions`, the synchronization process automatically includes it in the Community Resources section of the Resources page. You do not need to re-enter it into `rc42_resources_workflow`.

## Adding a resource

To add an academic resource:

1. Open `rc42_resources_workflow` in Google Drive.
2. Add a new row at the bottom of the spreadsheet.
3. Enter the `Title` and paste the active `URL`.
4. Set `Category` to `Publications`, `Teaching Resources`, or `Datasets & Tools`.
5. Set `Verification status` to `Verified official source`.
6. Set `Priority rank` (for example, `1` for top placement or `0` for default).
7. Enter relevant `Tags`, `Author / Institution`, and a brief `Description`.
8. Changes save automatically in Google Sheets.
9. Wait for the daily update or trigger an immediate update manually.

## Checking the published resource

To verify that the resource is published:

1. Visit `https://isa-rc42.org/resources/`.
2. Locate the corresponding category and confirm that the title, description, and link appear as expected.
3. If necessary, refresh your browser cache using `Ctrl + F5` (Windows) or `Cmd + Shift + R` (Mac).

## Common problems

* **Unverified status:** If `Verification status` is empty or set to `Pending`, the synchronization script skips the row.
* **Invalid URL:** Rows containing placeholder links (such as `#`) or missing URLs are excluded from publication.
